slides.h: The sky-image download is finished — and every file checks out
b: All 60,308 image bricks are on disk: 44,135 from stream A, 8,086 from B, 8,087 from C.
About 736 gigabytes, under the 922 gigabyte ceiling. Zero files quarantined.

slides.h: Every brick matches the producer's own checksum list
b: The final cross-check against Dustin Lang's list: 60,308 accepted, 60,308 matched, zero problems.
Our copy is byte-for-byte what the survey published.

slides.h: A reboot at 97 percent cost fifty minutes and nothing else
b: Debris archived, never deleted; three streams relaunched; shards merged back into one root with a computed record.

slides.h: The cutter and chi are draining the new bricks now
b: About 57,000 cutouts remain, then chi levels. A watcher re-runs the completion check when they do.

slides.h: The decline memo still waits for your signature
b: Sign it and the run halts, sample archived. Decline, and the frozen path continues toward a test both engines call underpowered.
Strata exists only if you do not sign. The successor can wait until September 5.
One nice line for Dustin: all 60,308 verified against your list.
